title: Super Mario 3D Land
shortDescription: A focused 3D platformer that brings Mario's movement and level rhythm to the Nintendo 3DS handheld family.
highlights: Short, structured stages that work well for handheld play
A clear bridge between side-scrolling precision and spatial 3D movement

signals.label: GameAtlas handheld selection
signals.rationale: A high-confidence Nintendo 3DS starting point: its compact stage structure and readable 3D movement make the platform's handheld design goals easy to discover.
